notes: Seeded from published Common Data Set / IPEDS-era figures. Entries marked confidence:'high' track widely published mid-50% bands; confidence:'medium' entries are best-known approximations and MUST be QA'd against the school's latest CDS before any partner-facing use.
null always means 'unpublished or unverified' — the report engine degrades to a qualitative statement rather than inventing a benchmark. It never means zero.

gpa is null across the board: CDS GPA reporting mixes weighted and unweighted scales too inconsistently to benchmark against. The gap engine uses admit-rate tier expectations for GPA instead. Populate per school during QA only with verified unweighted /4 figures.
testPolicy reflects the 2025-26 application cycle: required | optional | blind, null when unconfirmed. Blind schools carry null score bands by definition.

decisionPlans: offered:true with deadline:null means the plan exists but the date needs confirming. Deadlines are MM-DD within the application cycle. ed.admitRate is a fraction, included only where publicly reported.
internationalAdmitRate is null except where a school publishes it — most do not.
